name: Tumors
objectiveText: Bring 5 Mossy Tumors to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus. Mossy Tumor  ( 5 )

comments.body:
Drop wasn't that bad for me.. killed like 12-15 of the Elder Timberlings and got my 5 Moss.

To get to them just go to the Oracle Glade and turn right till you hit a Lake/River.

I read most of the posts on here and you all really confused me.  The place you can find the timberlings that drop the tumbers is about half way between Dolnaar and Darnassus.  It is north of the road (43, 41).  The south end of the lake makes like a circle (it pools) and there is a dock... if you see that you are in the right spot.  All of the different types of timberlings will drop the required items.  I only had to kill like 10 of them to get the five tumors.  DO NOT GO TO LAKE AL'AMETH the timberlings there do no drop the tumors. I hope this will help and happy hunting.
There are lots of timberling who will drop the tumors at 43,26 good luck...
For those who have been mislead, you can find Rellian Greenspyre at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. The coordinates are (38,21).
This is the lake with southern point at 42,42. Drop rate is decent maybe 30% or so.

Couldn't find Rellian when I had done the Q, (meybe because I don't know Darnassus so well yet) but if you have the same prob, /tloc 38,22 is his pos. in Darnassus..

Thottbot, says he's in darkshore :S

found at Wellspring River just east of Oracle Glade,Teldrassil. Timberlings Dire Beast drops more often than elder timberlings... only wasted about 5-10mins. there's also a millin of em at Lake Al'Meth just south of Dolanaar.
50% drop rate for me killing both of them (the yellow and the blue ones)
EASY! Go to wellspring lake, just right of the oracle glade and you will find it. Just kill about ten timberlings and u will get the tumors, u should be about level ten if u want it EASY!

just go south at the lake amreth or how its spelled... there youll find a cave with some timberling barklings and stamplers... i got the tumors in less than a hour. plus there is a lvl 9 elite waiting for you.
Around 43,35 I got like a 50% drop rate off Timberling Mire Beasts.

Wellspring Lake I think it was.I'm having a bear trying to kill a Rare monster..every1, I would recommend hovering ur cursor over the blue ones just in case u see a rare monster...I did :).(Yet died)
I got the tumor from the first guy I killed.

I've got 5 mossy tumors after killing only 5 timberlings!
i dont know why you other had to kill so many..
[b]42,33[/b] I got [u]ALL 5[/u] in under ten minutes here from the Timberling Mire Beasts. I think this is a good spot.
I'm standing right in front of him as I write this...Cenarion Enclave 38,21
Oh and when I went to turn in Mr. Greenspyre was in the exact s, pot he was at when I got the quest.. Darnassus (38, 21).

Omg i killed 6 at Wellspring Lake...really easy for lvl 10 rogue. Really Easy

REMEBER! WELLSPRING LAKE NOT LAKE AL'AMETH!

and the 9 elite (Oakenscowl) in the cave at Lake Alemeth is for a quest after this one!

Its not that hard. 

Killed 5 Timberling Tramplers at Wellspring River and got 5 Tumors. Took me ten minutes.

Level 9 Druid Comments:

Timberling Mire beasts at the above coords dropped almost all the time.  Only one beast failed to give me what I need.  Mobs were level 9-10 so it was a cakewalk.

i went to the spot i needed to go to, killed about 10 or 12 of them and had 4 tumors. i was a ways up the river so i headed back to darnssaus, planing on killing 2 or 3 of them on the way back. i killed about 20 and went back up the river. killed the first lvl 10 i saw and got the tumor. i came up with this. only kill lvl 10's or higher. better drop rate i guess.

Co-ordinates are around... 43, 26

That's the top of the river, they are found south of that as well.

It's tough to compare drop rates with only 5 items needed, but this is what I had:

Elder Timberling: 3 killed, 1 drop
Timberling Mire Beast: 4 killed, 3 drops
Timberling Trampler: 4 killed, 1 drop

If I go through this area with another low level character, I'll be targetting the mire beasts - those are the dark blueish/green ones
Drop rate of about 95% not bad considering the first time I tried with a level 9 rogue. Went back with a level 11 hunter (with a level 10 pet) and massacred them ;)
Easy quest that earns 975 experience and a nice lowbie dagger for a level 9 hunter.

Did it as a lvl 8 Priest

Been at this a good 30 mins now. 0 drops for me :/

Just did the quest with my lvl 9 hunter. Killed about 18 with only 2 drops. Logged out, logged back in, first one dropped. Did this 2 more times to complete it. Everytime you relog it seems to drop... Weird bugged quest but completed it anyway...

Trampler: 5 killed, 3 drop
Mire: 2 Killed, 2 drop

Easy.

Level 10 elf druid.
Killed 7 Timberling Trampler's at Wellspring Lake (43:41).
They dropped every other dropn then all dropped - I've noticed if you're a higher level then the thing you're killing then the drop rate is higher.
Experience gained: 975.
Reputation with Darnassus increased by 350.
This quest turned me into a lvl 13 druid on Nov. 28 it was pretty fun im lvl 16 currently.I liked it and by the way the blue timberlings over in Tedrassil are the ones u need the tumors from.
Kill the dark ones (Timberling Mire Beasts) not the light ones (Timblering Tramper).  They are by the dock at the end of the lake, or just north of it.
Forgot to add that they dropped % for me.  Just dont go to far from the dock or they wont drop.
This quest is simple. around 42,35 kill the mire ones. 100% drop for me solo lvl 9 hunter

Yes, go to the wellspring lake.  You can kill both the tramplings and the mires.  I got tumors from both of them.  The quest only took me about 15-20 min.

Hope this helps!

GL :)
